Custom keys: FreevendEnabled boolean RW true; FreevendIdTag string RW (default: serial number); TimeOffset string RW "-05:00"; NextTimeOffsetTransitionDateTime and TimeOffsetNextTransition string RW ""
ClearCache is answered Accepted but does nothing
FirmwareStatusNotification reports only Downloading, Installed, DownloadFailed, InstallationFailed
GetDiagnostics returns 7 days of logs, 300 lines / under 25 kB per day
SendLocalList: at most 8 idTags per list (20 characters each), 16 idTags in total
UnlockConnector is answered NotSupported on cable variants; this blueprint is the socket variant, which keeps the simulator's unlock behaviour
Connector type: Type 2 socket (with or without shutter); connector types are not modelled
